Base/OP pool-level guard was not exercised because their factoryV3 does not expose the canonical Uniswap V3 getPool ABI used in the PoC; code fingerprint and exact OP source match are the evidence there
OP internal native transfers could not be enumerated via Alchemy (internal unsupported); Blockscout shows only the creation tx and zero token transfers, current native balance 0
No mainnet transactions; all state changes are fork-only. No secrets or keyed RPC URLs are stored in this folder

latent_risk.trigger: first funding of any LM proxy plus the owner's first convertToV3/increaseLiquidity on a pool with observationCardinalityNext == 1
latent_risk.secondary_trigger: later owner op on a pool with no swap for >30 min (stale slot0 fail-open)
latent_risk.burner_trigger: real second-token inflow + setV3Pools(nonzero) + setMaxSlippages(nonzero); buyBack is permissionless
latent_risk.closure: changeImplementation to a build containing NotEnoughHistory()/_getPoolPriceFacts/RatioDeviation, or new deploy with MAX_ALLOWED_DEVIATION=2e16

recommendation: KEEP as re-arm monitor; do not remove. Live code is the unfixed 2026-05-12 build; the only missing ingredient is funding plus the owner's first convert.
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live (all three LM proxies empty, no transfers ever, all value-moving functions onlyOwner; all BuyBackBurners unfunded/unconfigured); the deployed 2026-05-12 core (d1d682e5) still fail-opens to manipulated slot0 on cardinality=1 or >30-min-quiet pools, so the first funding plus first convertToV3 re-arms a same-block sandwich worth ~20% of the first deposit (fork: +$1.70 on $5, LM mark-to-fair loss $1,036 on $5,184)
